why: A git hook runs with no dialog, and so does a package script it calls by name. Main found the name with a regular expression that took an option after run as the script name, so .husky/pre-commit with npm run --silent ai left the ai script, which starts an agent CLI with its approval switch off, a warning; npm run ai failed. Both sides track the same package.json, whose ai script is that invocation and whose lint script is not. The pass side hook runs npm run --silent lint, so ai stays a warning; the fail side hook runs npm run --silent ai. Reading the option as the name turns the fail side green; following every script of a package a hook touches turns the pass side red.
